title: KARMA: A Plug and Play Memory System for Embodied AI Agents

defines.name: KARMA
defines.definition: A plug-and-play memory system for embodied AI agents that combines long-term and short-term memory to improve LLM-based planning for long-sequence household tasks.

problem: Embodied AI agents struggle with in-context memory for long, interconnected household tasks, which leads to inefficient and error-prone execution.
